description: Published answers of Vargov®Design about ordering, production time, delivery, installation, certification, warranty, the configurator, BIM/IFC, colours and finishes, with the pages they come from. Answers are matched by the words of the question, not by meaning: up to three candidates, best word match first, each to be quoted as written only if it actually answers the question. found=false only when the question shares too few words with the published answers; when no answer fits, use the contact links for a manager. Works best with the question in English or Russian; lang sets the answer language (English where no translation exists).

lang.description: Language of the result: ru, en, de, it, fr, es, vi or ar. Default en.

question.description: The question, preferably in English or Russian.
